issue_title: [Bug] Todo dataclass allows empty text string, but Todo.rename() explicitly rejects it

plan.summary: Add validation in Todo.__post_init__ to reject empty text, making it consistent with rename() behavior.

files_to_touch.description: New test file with regression tests for empty text validation in Todo constructor

implementation_sequence.description: Modify Todo.__post_init__ to validate text field
changes: Strip text field and check if empty
Raise ValueError with message 'Todo text cannot be empty' if empty after strip

implementation_sequence.description: Run all tests to ensure no regressions

acceptance_criteria: Todo(id=1, text='') raises ValueError with message 'Todo text cannot be empty'
Todo(id=1, text='   ') raises ValueError with message 'Todo text cannot be empty'
Ruff check passes on modified files
risks: Some existing tests may use empty text strings and will need updates

implementation.summary: Added validation in Todo.__post_init__ to reject empty text strings, consistent with rename() behavior. The fix strips whitespace and raises ValueError with the same message 'Todo text cannot be empty' for empty or whitespace-only text.
acceptance_criteria_met: Todo(id=1, text='') raises ValueError with message 'Todo text cannot be empty'
Existing tests continue to pass (116 tests passed)
risks_noted: Existing code that creates Todo objects with whitespace-padded text will now have text stripped automatically
Code that was inadvertently creating Todo objects with empty/whitespace-only text will now fail with ValueError
